output.explanation: B05 adds frozen-evidence workflow generation, allocated changed-LOC treemaps, live source coverage, and retained AgentContext continuation. Existing ownership, navigation, retries and separate acceptance remain intact. Structural validation passes: nine edits fit scaffold bounds; Workflow/Treemap have 36/30 nodes, Evidence/Composer retain 40/32 nodes; positions are null and edges match the batch. Validation failure (source coverage): pinned sources omit the planned CLI entrypoint and change-treemap HTTP route adapter. Diagrams show the evidenced HTTP workflow client and treemap read boundary without inventing those implementations. Later push orchestration, durable Pi sessions and the saved-context library remain lookahead; this step establishes the workflow and continuation boundaries they can extend.
